description:
Small core PR (soundness path: scripts/site_inputs.py), then a small site change.

The live site serves 413 per-result JSON files at /results/data/bundles/<id>.json, and the Explorer links to them from each run's receipt (bundle_download_url). explorer_publish writes them, but site_inputs.py deletes them after building the snapshot, so a site built from the bundle has no files behind those links.

1. Core: keep explorer/bundles/ from explorer_publish as a required bundle member; bump the schema to 3; verify checks the member; tests.
2. Site: support schemas 2 and 3 (N and N-1); stage explorer/bundles/ into explorer/public/data/bundles/ before the Explorer build; a built-site test checks the published files match the bundle.
